Interface BuildingEffect

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ConfigurableEffect, InventorPairEffect, SetCompletionEffect
public interface BuildingEffect extends Serializable
Interface for Building card effects. All methods have default no-op implementations, so each concrete class only overrides the methods relevant to its specific effect. Methods are divided into two groups: - Triggers: called by Tribe when something happens. These act directly on the Player. - Queries: called by the game loop to check if a building modifies a rule. These return values that the game loop uses to make decisions.
